notes.text: Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (knee injury) and has missed the last 18 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (knee injury) and has missed the last 16 games. He is a top-six forward.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 25% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 42%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Miro Heiskanen is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Tyler Myers has taken his spot beside Esa Lindell.
Lian Bichsel is on injured reserve (lower-body injury), reported after he played in their last game.
Matt Duchene has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.

DAL.head: The Stars have a slight edge
DAL.body: Even though Dallas will be without Heiskanen, the Stars have home-ice advantage and have been out-chancing opponents lately. On top of that, Florida will be without Barkov. The Panthers can still swing it if they keep shots to a minimum.

story.head: Strength vs. Strength
paras: The Stars (10-6-2) lost 8-3 to Winnipeg on Thursday, while the Panthers have won two in a row. Going in, the Cats are fifth in the Atlantic (13th in the NHL) and the Stars fourth in the Central (tied for 14th).

The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st), hit a lot (1st) and don't block many shots (32nd). As for the Stars, they block more shots than anyone (1st). They also have the league’s most dangerous power play (1st), and their power play against the Panthers’ penalty killers is strength against strength. Both teams play slow, low-event hockey, especially the Stars (lowest), so expect a tight one.

Matthew Tkachuk (4 G / 24 A / 28 P in 20 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games. Sam Reinhart (11 G / 8 A / 19 P in 20 GP) has a team-high eleven goals, with a point in six straight games against Dallas. For the Stars, Mikko Rantanen (9 G / 12 A / 21 P in 18 GP) leads the way in scoring. Jason Robertson (9 G / 11 A / 20 P in 18 GP) isn’t far behind, with seven points in his last five games.
Akira Schmid (6-3-1 / .883 SV% in 9 GS) will likely start for Florida, and Casey DeSmith (1-2-1 / .894 SV% in 4 GS) for Dallas.
